summary: Processes collision damage decay across up to 4 per-frame active channels. Reads a rotating start index from this+0x31C, clears the active-damage flag byte this+0x320, renders the selection rectangle via UICursorSelectionRectangleRenderWithInterpolatio, computes a text-line advance from the screen width, scans up to 8 slots (92-byte stride) for a damage value greater than 0.0 at slot+144, renders damage text at slot+60 with the value at slot+140, subtracts the global cooling rate dbl_8AFE90 from the damage, sets the active flag if damage remains or resets the channel via PerIndexStructFieldResetter otherwise, and repeats up to 4 times.

operations.description: FloatArrayThresholdSearch() runs an initialization threshold/count search before the decay loop.
Read the rotating scan start index from this+0x31C into v2 and clear the active-damage flag byte this+0x320 to 0.
UICursorSelectionRectangleRenderWithInterpolatio((float*)this) renders the cursor selection rectangle each frame.
TwinFieldGetter_cf30(&v12, 0) retrieves a value used later for text positioning.
Compute the text-line advance v13 = CRTFtol(dword_5D6D64 * 0.035), converting the scaled screen width to an integer.
Scan loop: for v5 in 0..7, slot index v6 = (v5 + start) % 8, slot address v7 = 92 * v6 + this; stop when a slot's damage at v7+144 is greater than 0.0 or return when all 8 slots have been checked.
Break out of the scan when *(float*)(v7+144) > 0.0, and return early once v5 reaches 8 with no active damage slot.
TextRenderDispatcher(v7+60, v12/2, 0, *(v7+140), 2, -1.0, -1.0, 0) renders the damage text at the slot's screen position using the value stored at slot+140.
Decay the slot damage: v8 = *(float*)(v7+144) - dbl_8AFE90, then store v8 back to v7+144.
If the remaining damage v8 is greater than 0.0 set the active-damage flag this+0x320 to 1; otherwise reset the channel at index v6 via PerIndexStructFieldResetter((_DWORD*)this, v6).
Accumulate v3 += v13 and repeat the scan/decay pass while the pass counter v9 is less than 4, resuming the slot scan from v10.

unresolved: Owner object identity is unknown; the this-pointer carries both damage-channel state and UI rendering state.
The physical meaning of the slot data at stride 92 and the damage value at slot+144 is inferred, not runtime-proven.
flt_59E440 and flt_59F078 appear only in legacy analysis as physics thresholds; they have no raw-source grounding here.
The exact text content, color and formatting arguments passed to TextRenderDispatcher are caller/UI-determined.
